# Your Privacy Choices

Last updated: October 27, 2026

Our public website uses Google Analytics, which also measures our Google Ads, to see how people find us and which ads work. It never runs inside the JobProfitAI app and never sees your QuickBooks data. Some state laws treat this kind of measurement as a “sale” or “sharing” of personal information. You can opt out here. Our [Privacy Policy](/privacy#cookies) explains these tools in full.

## Opt out in this browser

*The switch on this page shows one of three messages, depending on the browser:*

- **Browser not sending Global Privacy Control, visitor has not opted out:** “Analytics and advertising in this browser: on. Our website pages can load Google Analytics, which also measures our Google Ads, in this browser. Turning it off also opts you out of the sale or sharing of your personal information and of targeted advertising through our website.” Button: “Turn off analytics and advertising.”
- **After the visitor turns them off:** “Analytics and advertising in this browser: off. You’ve turned off our analytics and advertising tags in this browser. They won’t load on our website while this choice is saved.” Button: “Turn them back on.”
- **Browser sending Global Privacy Control (no button):** “Global Privacy Control signal received and honored. Your browser is sending a Global Privacy Control signal. We treat it as a request to opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information and of targeted advertising, so our analytics and advertising tags don’t load in this browser. You don’t need to do anything else here.”

Your choice is saved in a cookie in this browser. If you clear your cookies, or use another browser or device, make the choice there too. A browser or extension that sends [Global Privacy Control](https://globalprivacycontrol.org) does this for you on every site that honors it, including ours.

Opting out stops our tags from collecting anything new in this browser. If you’re signed in to JobProfitAI when you opt out, or the next time you sign in from this browser, we also save the choice on your account, so it applies wherever you sign in and we stop reporting your sign-up, QuickBooks connection, checkout or subscription to Google from our servers. If you sign up while opted out, we never report them.

Opting out doesn’t delete what Google already holds. You can manage that in [Google’s ad settings](https://adssettings.google.com), and stop Google Analytics on every website with the [Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout).

## Other requests

To opt out by email instead, or to ask us to access, correct or delete your information, or to stop contacting you, email [support@jobprofitai.com](mailto:support@jobprofitai.com). We don’t sell personal information for money, and we never use your QuickBooks data, jobs, customers or figures for advertising. The [Your choices and rights](/privacy#rights) section of our Privacy Policy explains each request and how we handle it.
